periods.description: An experimental Drag-Ride developed by Lisha by combining Wyvern and Wyrm characteristics, requiring dual Sword Devices and imposing a high control burden.

details.construction: fusion of Wyvern and Wyrm halves
details.controls: requires two Sword Devices and dual control
details.performance: around 1.5x general-purpose Drag-Ride performance but near Divine Drag-Ride difficulty

history: shown to Lux in Lisha's workshop
used by Lisha during Lux's Knight Squadron test
damaged by Belbet's surprise attack before Lisha switches to Tiamat
